verdict.rationale: Airweave's own quickstart documents running the product yourself: clone the GitHub repo, run ./start.sh, and open a local dashboard at localhost:8080. A community comment places it in the open source space. The documented scope is local deployment on macOS, Linux or WSL only. missing for 10: production self-hosting guidance (e.g. Docker/Kubernetes/server deployment, configuration, scaling), confirmation of feature parity between self-hosted and hosted versions, and independent hands-on reports of self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: If you prefer to run Airweave yourself, you can deploy it locally on macOS, Linux or WSL.
After cloning the repository and starting the server, you will be able to open the dashboard at http://localhost:8080
Always great to have more innovation in the open source AI space
